_comment: SH1315 — what each curator task costs in the console today. clicks, keys and screens gate at the measurement with no headroom; ms is printed and never gated. Re-record with `node e2e/curator-tasks.mjs --record`, which keeps each why. A task a filed defect stops is `blocked` until it completes.

change-headline.why: The headline is the hero section's, and a page's section list does not open its sections (SH1323), so the path is search → section → field → Actions → Publish → confirm.

approve-run.why: Home names the waiting run and the queue approves in one press, with no confirmation: the reference for what a curator decision can cost.

replace-image.why: A filled image field opens the picker on its own folder, so a replace is search → Search → file → Select → publish. An empty field opens on every site and is SH1325's path.

find-page.why: Ctrl+K, the title, and the result: the floor every other task's first step is measured against.

create-page.why: Content opens a hub, the site list is a card on it, the new-post form only saves, saving returns to the folder, and a table row opens on double-click, so publishing a new page crosses seven screens (SH1326).

preview-draft.blocked: SH1322 — the preview of a never-published page is Spring's Whitelabel 404
preview-draft.why: The draft only exists as a draft, which is the case a preview is for.
